problem.passage:
An economic historian is studying two historical trade routes, Route 1 and Route 2, that were used to transport goods between two regions during the 19th century. Based on toll records, the total shipping cost, in silver coins, to transport $n$ crates along each route is modeled by a linear equation. For Route 1, shipping 10 crates cost 260 silver coins, and shipping 30 crates cost 620 silver coins. For Route 2, shipping 10 crates cost 200 silver coins, and shipping 30 crates cost 680 silver coins. Line $r$ represents Route 1 and line $s$ represents Route 2, as shown in the figure, where the horizontal axis represents the number of crates $n$ and the vertical axis represents the total shipping cost, in silver coins. The historian wants to identify the number of crates for which the two routes would have cost the same amount to ship.

For how many crates $n$ do Route 1 and Route 2 have the same total shipping cost, according to the system of equations represented by lines $r$ and $s$?

problem.question: For how many crates $n$ do Route 1 and Route 2 have the same total shipping cost, according to the system of equations represented by lines $r$ and $s$?
problem.explanation:
Route 1의 두 점 (10, 260), (30, 620)으로부터 기울기는 (620-260)/(30-10) = 360/20 = 18이고, 260 = 18(10) + b에서 b = 80이므로 Route 1의 식은 y = 18n + 80이다.

Route 2의 두 점 (10, 200), (30, 680)으로부터 기울기는 (680-200)/(30-10) = 480/20 = 24이고, 200 = 24(10) + b에서 b = -40이므로 Route 2의 식은 y = 24n - 40이다.

두 식을 연립하면 18n + 80 = 24n - 40이 되고, 120 = 6n이므로 n = 20이다.

이 문제는 SPR(주관식 단답) 형식이므로 선택지는 없으며, 학생은 두 지점(n=10, n=30)에서의 비용 정보로부터 각 경로의 기울기와 절편을 정확히 구성한 뒤 연립방정식을 풀어 n = 20을 도출해야 한다. 흔한 오류로는 (1) 한 경로의 정보만 사용해 절편을 잘못 구하는 경우, (2) 두 좌표를 뒤바꿔 기울기의 부호를 반대로 계산하는 경우, (3) 절편을 구할 때 n=10 대신 n=30 값을 잘못 대입해 상수항을 틀리게 계산하는 경우가 있으며, 이런 실수를 하면 n = 20이 아닌 다른 값(예: n = 12, n = 15, n = 24 등)이 나온다.

정답: 20
